data.fund_name: Nippon India ETF Hang Seng BeES
data.fund_type: An open ended index Scheme, investing in overseas Securities listed on the Exchange in the form of an Exchange Traded Fund(ETF) tracking the Hang Seng Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of Nippon India ETF Hang Seng BeES is to provide returns that, before expenses, closely correspondto the total returns of Securities as represented by Hang Seng Index of Hang Seng Data Services Limited, by investing in theSecurities in the same proportion as in the index. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of theScheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Securities constituting Hang Seng Index - 95% to 100% , Money Market Instruments- 0% to 5%. (with maturity not exceeding91 days), including Tri-party repo on G-sec or T-bills, cash & cash equivalents, mutual fund schemes/ overseas exchangetraded funds based on Hang Seng Index
